user.title: Adaptative Climate
user.description: Create an adaptative climate entity. Choose a source climate entity for each mode; a mode without a source is not shown. The same entity can serve several modes. Without a heat/cool mode entity, the heat/cool mode uses the heat and cool entities.

data.name: Name
data.min_gap: Minimum gap between heating and cooling targets
data.min_phase_duration: Minimum time in heating or cooling before switching (heat/cool)

data_description.heat_offset: Optional, 0 by default. How much warmer than the room the climate entity of this mode reads (negative: colder). It gets the target plus this offset, and its target and temperature minus this offset are shown.
data_description.heat_external_sensor: Optional. A number or input_number entity the climate entity of this mode regulates with (external temperature of a TRV, probe). It gets the temperature of the temperature sensor, which is then required; the offset of this mode is ignored.
data_description.cool_offset: Optional, 0 by default. How much warmer than the room the climate entity of this mode reads (negative: colder). It gets the target plus this offset, and its target and temperature minus this offset are shown.
data_description.cool_external_sensor: Optional. A number or input_number entity the climate entity of this mode regulates with (external temperature of a TRV, probe). It gets the temperature of the temperature sensor, which is then required; the offset of this mode is ignored.
data_description.heat_cool_offset: Optional, 0 by default. How much warmer than the room the climate entity of this mode reads (negative: colder). It gets the target plus this offset, and its target and temperature minus this offset are shown.
data_description.heat_cool_external_sensor: Optional. A number or input_number entity the climate entity of this mode regulates with (external temperature of a TRV, probe). It gets the temperature of the temperature sensor, which is then required; the offset of this mode is ignored.
data_description.auto_offset: Optional, 0 by default. How much warmer than the room the climate entity of this mode reads (negative: colder). It gets the target plus this offset, and its target and temperature minus this offset are shown.
data_description.auto_external_sensor: Optional. A number or input_number entity the climate entity of this mode regulates with (external temperature of a TRV, probe). It gets the temperature of the temperature sensor, which is then required; the offset of this mode is ignored.
data_description.dry_offset: Optional, 0 by default. How much warmer than the room the climate entity of this mode reads (negative: colder). It gets the target plus this offset, and its target and temperature minus this offset are shown.
data_description.dry_external_sensor: Optional. A number or input_number entity the climate entity of this mode regulates with (external temperature of a TRV, probe). It gets the temperature of the temperature sensor, which is then required; the offset of this mode is ignored.
data_description.fan_only_offset: Optional, 0 by default. How much warmer than the room the climate entity of this mode reads (negative: colder). It gets the target plus this offset, and its target and temperature minus this offset are shown.
data_description.fan_only_external_sensor: Optional. A number or input_number entity the climate entity of this mode regulates with (external temperature of a TRV, probe). It gets the temperature of the temperature sensor, which is then required; the offset of this mode is ignored.
data_description.temperature_sensor: Optional. Room temperature shown by the entity. Without a heat/cool mode climate entity, the heat/cool mode switches between the heat and cool climate entities using it. Leave empty to use the temperature of the climate entities.
data_description.sync_modes: Optional. These modes share their fan and swing settings. A mode without a climate entity is ignored.
data_description.min_temp: Optional. Leave empty to follow the minimum of the climate entity in use. Can only raise it.
data_description.max_temp: Optional. Leave empty to follow the maximum of the climate entity in use. Can only lower it.
data_description.min_gap: Minimum gap between heating and cooling targets
data_description.min_phase_duration: Optional, in minutes (10 by default). Without a heat/cool mode climate entity, the heat/cool mode stays this long in heating or cooling before switching to the other one by itself. 0: switch at once. A change of the targets switches at once.
data_description.monitoring_gap: Optional, 2 by default. The monitoring sensor turns on when the room sensor and a climate entity, or two climate entities, read temperatures further apart than this (each one minus the offset of its mode).
data_description.monitoring_duration: Optional, in minutes (15 by default). A gap is a problem once it lasted this long. 0: at once.

error.min_max_invalid: The minimum temperature must be lower than the maximum temperature.
error.self_reference: An Adaptative Climate entity cannot be used as a source.
error.no_source: Choose a climate entity for at least one mode.
error.mode_not_supported: The selected climate entity does not support this mode.
error.external_sensor_without_sensor: An external sensor needs the temperature sensor.

abort.invalid_yaml: The YAML configuration of this entry is invalid. Check the logs.

source_unavailable.message: The source of mode {hvac_mode} ({entity_id}) is unavailable.

source_mode_not_supported.message: The source of mode {hvac_mode} ({entity_id}) does not offer this mode.

mode_not_supported.title: {entity_id} does not offer the {hvac_mode} mode
mode_not_supported.description: {name} uses {entity_id} for the {hvac_mode} mode, but this entity does not offer that mode, so the mode cannot be used. Choose another climate entity for this mode in the configuration of {name}, or remove it. This issue disappears once fixed.
